equipment.name: Copper Dagger
equipment.description: A short blade of dull grey Copper. The first real weapon anyone out here owns.

equipment.name: Copper Sword
equipment.description: Two bars of Copper beaten flat and given an edge. Heavier than the dagger, and hits like it.

equipment.name: Pine Shield
equipment.description: Planks of pale march wood banded at the rim. It stops a claw once.

equipment.name: Copper Helm
equipment.description: An open-faced cap. You can hear things coming, which is most of the job.

equipment.name: Copper Cuirass
equipment.description: A plate front laced over a leather back. Cheap, loud, and better than nothing.

equipment.name: Copper Greaves
equipment.description: Shin and thigh plates on a march-issue belt.

equipment.name: Copper Boots
equipment.description: Iron-shod boots for scree and bracken.

equipment.name: Copper Gloves
equipment.description: Studded gloves. They keep the grip when the haft goes wet.

equipment.name: Pine Wand
equipment.description: Pale wood with an empty socket at the tip. It stays unlit until upgraded.

equipment.name: Pine Staff
equipment.description: A pale two-handed shaft with an empty socket. The wood itself gives off no light.

equipment.name: Hide Hood
equipment.description: Cured wolf hide, hood up against the march wind.

equipment.name: Hide Robe
equipment.description: Three hides stitched into something between a coat and a tent.

equipment.name: Hide Leggings
equipment.description: Hide leggings, laced at the calf.

equipment.name: Hide Boots
equipment.description: Soft-soled. Quiet, which matters more than it sounds.

equipment.name: Hide Wraps
equipment.description: Hide strips wound to the knuckle, fingertips left bare.

equipment.name: Iron Dagger
equipment.description: Deepwood steel, dark and slightly oily to the touch.

equipment.name: Iron Sword
equipment.description: A long Iron blade. The standard by which a Woodlands hand is judged.

equipment.name: Ash Shield
equipment.description: Laminated ash over an Iron boss. Heavy enough to lean on.

equipment.name: Iron Helm
equipment.description: A full helm with a narrow sight slit.

equipment.name: Iron Plate
equipment.description: Three bars of Iron, articulated at the waist so you can still bend to pick things up.

equipment.name: Iron Greaves
equipment.description: Plated legs. Slower over a root field, worth it under a husk.

equipment.name: Iron Boots
equipment.description: Plated over the toe, soft in the sole. Deepwood floor is not forgiving.

equipment.name: Iron Gauntlets
equipment.description: Fingered plate. You can hold a rod in these, badly.

equipment.name: Ash Wand
equipment.description: Dark ash with an empty crown. Its polished wood remains unlit on its own.

equipment.name: Ash Staff
equipment.description: Dark ash banded in Iron around an empty, unlit crown.

equipment.name: Thick Hide Hood
equipment.description: Deepwood hide, still faintly thorned along the seam.

equipment.name: Thick Hide Robe
equipment.description: Heavy hide, waxed. Sheds a Thornbound's spores and most of the rain.

equipment.name: Thick Hide Leggings
equipment.description: Long hide leggings cut for a full stride.

equipment.name: Thick Hide Boots
equipment.description: Laced to the knee against the root field.

equipment.name: Thick Hide Wraps
equipment.description: Wrapped to the second knuckle. Casting hand stays free.

equipment.name: Cobalt Dagger
equipment.description: A punch of black Cobalt with a needle point. It goes through moor-rot like paper.

equipment.name: Cobalt Sword
equipment.description: Hillcrest's best. Cobalt holds an edge through stone, which is the whole point up here.

equipment.name: Oak Shield
equipment.description: Oak faced in Cobalt. It rings when a bear hits it, and the bear stops.

equipment.name: Cobalt Helm
equipment.description: A closed helm with a stone-cutter's brow ridge.

equipment.name: Cobalt Plate
equipment.description: Three bars of Cobalt. Quarry crews were buried in these, which is not a selling point.

equipment.name: Cobalt Greaves
equipment.description: Full leg plate, hinged at the knee.

equipment.name: Cobalt Boots
equipment.description: Cleated for wet cairn stone.

equipment.name: Cobalt Gauntlets
equipment.description: Cobalt over the knuckle, garnet rivets. Loud.

equipment.name: Oak Wand
equipment.description: Resin-dark oak with an empty Cobalt socket and no light of its own.

equipment.name: Oak Staff
equipment.description: A two-handed oak shaft with an empty Cobalt cage. It stays dark until upgraded.

equipment.name: Fur Hood
equipment.description: Cut from a bear's winter coat. It does not take dye and it does not tear.

equipment.name: Fur Robe
equipment.description: Three pelts, stitched with Cobalt wire. Quarry Warden's floor is survivable in this.

equipment.name: Fur Leggings
equipment.description: Pelt to the ankle, weighted at the hem so it does not lift on the moor.

equipment.name: Fur Boots
equipment.description: Silent on stone. The quarry crews would have hated them.

equipment.name: Fur Wraps
equipment.description: Pelt strips to the wrist. Garnet dust worked into the weave.

equipment.name: Cave Ogre Sword
equipment.description: Cobalt worked smooth as sea glass. It swings like it remembers the water.

equipment.name: Cave Ogre Staff
equipment.description: Oak bleached and salt-cured. The cage weeps a little in the cold.

equipment.name: Galeskin Sword
equipment.description: Copper pattern, but the edge whistles on the backswing. A spare blade from Galeskin's guarded store.

equipment.name: Galeskin Staff
equipment.description: Pine scoured silver by Fallowmarch wind. The empty socket hums before a gust.

equipment.name: Forest Ogre Sword
equipment.description: A Iron blade grown through with moss that will not die. It never rusts.

equipment.name: Forest Ogre Staff
equipment.description: Ash with a living green seam. Warm at the grip like a root in summer.

equipment.name: Titanium Dagger
equipment.description: A hand-width of Titanium that never fully cools. It goes in easier than it comes out.

equipment.name: Titanium Sword
equipment.description: Kiln-forged and quenched twice. The edge holds a dull orange line in the dark.

equipment.name: Walnut Shield
equipment.description: Layered walnut faced in Titanium. Built to withstand heavy blows.

equipment.name: Titanium Helm
equipment.description: A closed helm with a smoke-vent crown. Built for standing close to heat.

equipment.name: Titanium Plate
equipment.description: Five bars of Titanium. It keeps the warmth of the forge for a full day's walk.

equipment.name: Titanium Greaves
equipment.description: Full leg plate, smoke-blued. Ember and scree both stay outside it.

equipment.name: Titanium Boots
equipment.description: Soled in heavy hide over Titanium shanks. Warm ground stops mattering.

equipment.name: Titanium Gauntlets
equipment.description: Fingered plate with fire-opal rivets. They tick as they cool.

equipment.name: Walnut Wand
equipment.description: Polished walnut with an empty Titanium socket. It stays unlit until the altar takes it.

equipment.name: Walnut Staff
equipment.description: A two-handed walnut shaft crowned with an empty Titanium cage, dark until charged.

equipment.name: Heavy Hide Hood
equipment.description: Seared hide with the grain still showing. Kiln heat rolls off it.

equipment.name: Heavy Hide Robe
equipment.description: Three heavy hides stitched with Titanium wire. The Fire Ogre arena is survivable in this.

equipment.name: Heavy Hide Leggings
equipment.description: Heavy Hide to the ankle, weighted so foothill gusts leave it alone.

equipment.name: Heavy Hide Boots
equipment.description: Silent on warm rock. Ash does not hold a footprint in these.

equipment.name: Heavy Hide Wraps
equipment.description: Seared strips wound to the wrist, fire-opal dust in the weave.

equipment.name: Fire Ogre Sword
equipment.description: Titanium quenched in the arena's own spring. The orange line down the edge never fades.

equipment.name: Fire Ogre Staff
equipment.description: Walnut the fire chose not to eat. The empty cage sheds a slow drift of sparks.

equipment.name: Dewglass Sword
equipment.description: Translucent turquoise mineral-metal with pearly silver edges, overlapping leaf-shaped plates and dark leather straps. A solid double-edged blade with beveled cutting edges, a shaped crossguard and a wrapped wood grip.

equipment.name: Willow Shield
equipment.description: Pale willow with bent flowing grain, turquoise bindings and pearly silver Dewglass fittings. A curved layered-wood shield with a reinforced metal rim, central boss and two leather straps on its back.

equipment.name: Dewglass Helm
equipment.description: Translucent turquoise mineral-metal with pearly silver edges, overlapping leaf-shaped plates and dark leather straps. A fitted helmet with a raised brow, layered cheek guards and a protective nape.

equipment.name: Dewglass Plate
equipment.description: Translucent turquoise mineral-metal with pearly silver edges, overlapping leaf-shaped plates and dark leather straps. A shaped breastplate and backplate with overlapping shoulder plates, a fitted waist and articulated lower lames.

equipment.name: Dewglass Greaves
equipment.description: Translucent turquoise mineral-metal with pearly silver edges, overlapping leaf-shaped plates and dark leather straps. A matched pair of leg guards with separate thigh shells, raised knee cups and shin plates over leather lining.

equipment.name: Dewglass Boots
equipment.description: Translucent turquoise mineral-metal with pearly silver edges, overlapping leaf-shaped plates and dark leather straps. A matched pair of leather-soled boots with overlapping metal toe plates, ankle guards and rear buckles.

equipment.name: Dewglass Gauntlets
equipment.description: Translucent turquoise mineral-metal with pearly silver edges, overlapping leaf-shaped plates and dark leather straps. A matched pair of five-fingered gauntlets with articulated knuckles, flared cuffs and leather palms.

equipment.name: Willow Wand
equipment.description: Pale willow with bent flowing grain, turquoise bindings and pearly silver Dewglass fittings. A short tapered wand with a wrapped grip and a small crystal held in an open metal tip cage. One-handed; carried Essence pays for spells.

equipment.name: Willow Staff
equipment.description: Pale willow with bent flowing grain, turquoise bindings and pearly silver Dewglass fittings. A long willow staff with a bent branch loop around a Dewglass crystal. Two-handed; carried Essence pays for spells.

equipment.name: Mistweave Hood
equipment.description: Layered blue-green cloth with pointed petal panels, pale embroidered seams and softly shaded folds. A deep open-faced hood with an embroidered brow, folded lining and a short shoulder cowl.

equipment.name: Mistweave Robe
equipment.description: Layered blue-green cloth with pointed petal panels, pale embroidered seams and softly shaded folds. A fitted robe with flared sleeves, pale botanical embroidery and split pointed tails.

equipment.name: Mistweave Leggings
equipment.description: Layered blue-green cloth with pointed petal panels, pale embroidered seams and softly shaded folds. A fitted pair of trousers with a reinforced waistband, separate legs, stitched knee panels and tapered ankle cuffs.

equipment.name: Mistweave Boots
equipment.description: Layered blue-green cloth with pointed petal panels, pale embroidered seams and softly shaded folds. A matched pair of soft casting boots with turned cuffs, side lacing, embroidered uppers and dark leather soles.

equipment.name: Mistweave Wraps
equipment.description: Layered blue-green cloth with pointed petal panels, pale embroidered seams and softly shaded folds. A matched pair of fingerless hand wraps with layered wrist bands, fitted thumb openings and embroidered cuff borders.

equipment.name: Dewglass Pickaxe
equipment.description: Pale willow with bent flowing grain, turquoise bindings and pearly silver Dewglass fittings. A curved two-ended Dewglass mining head with a pointed pick and a flat chisel. Adds 24 effective gathering levels; resource requirements still apply.

equipment.name: Dewglass Hatchet
equipment.description: Pale willow with bent flowing grain, turquoise bindings and pearly silver Dewglass fittings. A broad bearded Dewglass axe head with a honed edge and wedge-fastened eye. Adds 24 effective gathering levels; resource requirements still apply.

equipment.name: Willow Rod
equipment.description: Pale willow with bent flowing grain, turquoise bindings and pearly silver Dewglass fittings. A flexible fishing rod with spaced line guides, a working reel, crank knob and hanging float. Adds 24 effective gathering levels; resource requirements still apply.
